failedAssertions.reason: The dashboard does not settle cleanly after load because the loading banner remains visible alongside loaded content.
Browser history is not inert for dashboard interactions because Back leaves the app to about:blank before Forward returns.
The UI still presents conflicting recency semantics by mixing a fresh global label with a stale goal card on the same screen.
The transitions remain misleading because refresh failure overlays stale prior content and retry recovery still leaves a lingering loading banner in the settled state.
Refresh preserves the narrowed subset, but the post-refresh state is still incoherent because the loading UI remains visible after content has settled.
The dedicated blocked section never rendered even though overview rows included visible 'At risk' items.
Blocked visibility still does not respond to scoping; the callout stays absent in both overview and scoped states.
Blocked ownership/count details are still missing from the goal cards.
The top-level freshness badge still conflicts with the stale goal-card state instead of reflecting sheet recency.
Escape does not unwind state in the required priority order; it leaves stale scope UI, open row details, and visible filter controls behind.
Goal scoping still updates summary and table without updating any blocked surface.
Reset restored overview data but left stale department-scope UI behind and still did not restore any blocked section.
